description: This record describes the CoSES ProHMo library, a Modelica-based simulation library that forms the digital twin of the district heating prosumer laboratory of the Center for Combined Smart Energy Systems at the Technical University of Munich, presented at the ICAE 2022 conference. The library holds new, accurate models of condensing boilers, air-source and ground-source heat pumps and combined heat and power units, plus tuned models of thermal storage and heat consumption, parametrised from laboratory measurements and neglecting pressure losses to save simulation time. It can be exported through the Functional Mock-up Interface to other programs or used in NI VeriStand for power-hardware-in-the-loop and software-in-the-loop experiments, and a case study on an emulated house found unanticipated interactions between the generators and the internal controllers of commercial hardware. Access: the paper is a free PDF and the paper states the library is published on GitHub; no licence is stated in the text. Coverage is a laboratory setup at building scale. Caveats: the repository page was not opened, so its licence and current state are unknown. It suits digital twin and network flow studies of thermal prosumers in district heating, and relates to the Functional Mock-up Interface specification record catalogued here.
